result.notes: Free self-serve tier (100 tokens/month, no card) via app.mrscraper.com/playground gives an API key usable as query param (?token=), header (x-api-token), or Bearer token. Official hosted MCP server also supports OAuth 2.1 browser sign-in in addition to API-key fallback. REST API Reference documents endpoints; exact count not confirmed on vendor docs but Composio catalog lists 11 wrapped tools, suggesting a small surface (scraping/bulk-scraping/proxy/scheduling focused). api_breadth marked "small" with lower confidence since full endpoint count wasn't directly verified on docs.mrscraper.com.
result.one_liner: MrScraper is an AI-powered and manual web scraping platform (scraper API, bulk scraping, residential proxy, web unblocker) with REST API, CLI, SDKs, and an official MCP server.
